classifications.finding: Explicit ISO-8859-1 child treats FF FE, FE FF, and EF BB BF as ordinary Latin1 characters in Expat; Oriole returns IncorrectEncoding19. All widths0/1/2/3 reproduce.
classifications.source: Oriole encoding.rs266-275 rejects every sniffed/requested BOM conflict. Pinned Expat xmltok.c1571,1581,1595,1608 bypass BOM recognition for Latin1 in XML_CONTENT_STATE.
classifications.bounded_followup: Introduce correct external-content initialization context rather than globally weakening document/DTD BOM checks; preserve explicit UTF16 and custom encoding contracts.

classifications.classification: Concrete pre-existing external-general-entity UTF16LE autodetection gap
classifications.finding: With no protocol, a\0b\0c\0 fails InvalidToken4 in Expat but Oriole accepts abc at all widths0/1/2/3. Leading-NUL BE, LE markup beginning<\0, BOM-labelled LE, and explicitUTF16LE all match. ExplicitUTF8 preserves InvalidToken4 in both.
classifications.source: Oriole encoding.rs244 sniffs UTF16LE from any NUL second byte. Expat xmltok.c1636 explicitly declines that inference in XML_CONTENT_STATE while retaining it in document prolog state; first-byteNUL BE inference remains supported.
classifications.bounded_followup: Context-sensitive LE sniffing; do not disable BE sniffing or <NUL detection.

classifications.finding: Pinned MiscEncodingHandler prefix-conv returns ASCII101(e),111(o),109(m),110(n),112(p) through two-byte callbacks. Oriole rejects the first ASCII result4 as documented. Ordinary ASCII map-only long-name2 and nonASCII converter result192 pass in both.
classifications.source: handlers.c349 prefix_converter; basic_tests.c4770/4805. Oriole encoding.rs459-463 rejects converter ASCII; C README57-63 and97ff documents restriction.
classifications.bounded_followup: No defect fix in this layer; retaining alternate byte-form lexical provenance would be a separate design change.

classifications.finding: Expat rejects U+10000 in name and U+0901 at name start. Oriole accepts both under XML1.0 FifthEdition; U+0901 after ASCII name starter succeeds in both. All widths0/1/3 match classification.
classifications.source: basic_tests.c442 and case19 of test_utf8_in_start_tags (U+0901). Oriole names.rs NameStartChar ranges include U+037F..U+1FFF andU+10000..U+EFFFF.

scope: Read-only source inspection and direct public C API probes. No source edits or builds; callback invocation counts were recorded but excluded from semantic equivalence.
